provenance.author: Vitaly Zdanevich
provenance.changed: Selected one continuous shot, removed sound, made 480p source cuts, solved cameras, and trained real Gaussian splats through Splat.js. Compact model budget, initially 256 px training. The last continuation completed 102 additional steps at up to 640 px, reusing the recorded cameras and learned model.
provenance.changes: Independently fitted 640px phone and 960px desktop Gaussian models from the existing capture span, then quantized into BKD1. Capture spans, licenses, and source IDs are retained. Cameras were solved again at the frozen source timestamps with COLMAP. Made by Ryan with Codex (GPT-6).

fallbackEncoding.changes: Omitted unused vertex normals; every decoded Gaussian parameter is bit-identical.
